definition: [ כָּבִיר ] noun [masculine] probably something netted , i.e. either a quilt or ( Ew H. 8. 77 Ke ) a fly-net ( κωνωπεῖον ) spread over the face while a person was asleep; 1Sam 19:13 ; 1Sam 19:16 כְּבִיר הָעִזִּים a quilt (or fly-net ) of goats (' hair). See further Dr on the passage
